newsitem.title: CANADA: Toronto stocks open higher, eye on FOMC meeting.
newsitem.headline: Toronto stocks open higher, eye on FOMC meeting.

text.p: * Toronto stocks opened stronger on Tuesday, continuing Monday's late day strength. * Market players await FOMC results. * 8 million shares traded worth C$175 million.

Toronto's key stock index ticked higher at Tuesday's open, extending Monday's late session rebound while many investors bet the U.S. Federal Open Market Committee would keep short-term interest rates steady.
"The market is up based on the strong close yesterday," one trader said. "People are still Fed watching."
The U.S. rate-policy meeting is expected to unveil results at about 1415 EDT/ 1815 GMT.
The trader forecast that beyond daily fluctuations the stock market would move sideways for the next few weeks.
